facts.fact: 她揉眼再睁——那个女人还在。
facts.anchor: Rubbing my eyes with the heels of my hand until I’m seeing orbs of colour, I fully expect the figure to have disappeared when I dare to reopen them.

facts.fact: 女人上前把手搭上他的肩——只有 Cassie 吓一跳，Finlay 毫无反应。
facts.anchor: The figure steps closer, places a hand on his shoulder, but I’m the one who jumps at the touch. He doesn’t flinch.

facts.fact: 他信了她的话——她头一次也开始相信自己。
facts.anchor: He believes me, and for the very first time, I’m starting to believe in myself, too.

facts.fact: 他的反应反常：几乎不追问——换成她早该连珠炮似地问为什么、怎么死的。
facts.anchor: Because I did expect more questions. And if the shoe were on the other foot, I’d be falling over myself, begging him to tell me why or how.

facts.fact: 她以为他要吻她，等来的却是掏出的钱包和一沓二十镑——「我该付你多少？」
facts.anchor: but instead of pulling me into him, he reaches his arm behind his back and pulls his wallet from his pocket. Flipping it open, exposing a bundle of twenty-pound notes, he points it towards me.

facts.fact: 她踉跄后退，脸颊红得像挨了一巴掌——羞耻感翻江倒海。
facts.anchor: I stumble back, my cheeks burning crimson red as if he just slapped me across the jaw.

facts.fact: 临走他回身喊道：你不会让我难过——照顾好自己，也许我们有缘再见，还给了个 wink。
facts.anchor: ‘I don’t think you could ever upset me. Look after yourself, OK? Maybe our paths will cross again someday.’

facts.fact: 她缩回空屋，只想到一句：所有人最后都会走。
facts.anchor: I don’t know why I’m so shocked. Everyone always leaves.
